semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: 'Model-agnostic interpretability' concerns methods and techniques to understand and explain the decisions of models without regard to any specific type of model. This aligns with the broader focus of 'model interpretability' which covers the same conceptual ground of making models understandable.

'Interpretability' is a broad term that includes understanding and explaining models, applicable to both model-specific and model-agnostic cases. Thus, it is semantically equivalent as it encompasses 'model-agnostic interpretability' within its scope.
